spec.expr:
{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", namespace=~"${namespace:raw}", container=~"${container:raw}"} 
| json
|= "$log_query"
| line_format `{{.container}}	|{{.app}}|{{ if not (eq .msg "")}}{{.msg}}{{else}}{{__line__}}{{end}}`
max by(instance, device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", instance=~"${instance:raw}", device=~"/dev/.*", mountpoint="/"})
max by(instance, device) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes/node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", instance=~"${instance:raw}", device=~"/dev/.*", mountpoint="/"} )
max by(container, pod) (container_memory_rss{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", instance=~"${instance:raw}", namespace=~"${namespace:raw}", pod=~"${pod:raw}", container=~"${container:raw}"})

sum by(pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", instance=~"${instance:raw}", namespace=~"${namespace:raw}", pod=~"${pod:raw}", container=~"${container:raw}"}[$interval]))
